तिम् तिम्, cl. 4. P. तिम्यति, तितेम, &c.,
to be or become wet or damp &c.; to
become pacified or quiet: Intens. तेतिम्यते; [cf.
rt. तीम् and स्तिम्.]

तीम् तीम्, cl. 4. P. तीम्यति, &c., to be
wet or moist; [cf. rt. तिम्.]

तिमित, अस्, आ, अम्, moistened, moist, wet, damp;
quiet; unmoved, unshaken; steady, fixed.
तिमित तिमित. See under rt. तिम् above.

तिमि तिमि, इस्, or sometimes तिम, अस्, m.
(said to be fr. rt. तम्), a kind of whale or fabulous
fish of an enormous size, said to be 100 Yojanas
long; a fish in general; the figure of a fish produced
by drawing two lines, one intersecting the other at
right angles; the ocean; N. of a son of Dūrva and
father of Bṛhad-ratha; (इस्, ई), f. a fish; N. of a
daughter of Dakṣa who was the wife of Kaśyapa
and mother of the sea-monsters.
—तिमि-कोष or
तिमि-कोषक, अस्, m. the ocean (‘the receptacle of
great fish’).
—तिमिङ्-गिल, अस्, m. ‘swallowing even
the Timi,’ a large fabulous fish; (आस्), m. pl., N. of
a people in Dakṣiṇā-patha; (अस्), m. a prince of
this people.
—तिमिङ्गिल-गिल, अस्, m. a large
fabulous fish (‘swallowing even the Timiṅ-gila’).
—तिमि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, coming or derived from the
Timi, a sort of pearl.
—तिमि-तिमिङ्-गिल, अस्, m.
a large fabulous fish.
—तिमि-ध्वज, अस्, आ, अम्,
‘having a Timi depicted in his banner,’ epithet of
the Asura Śambara, prince of Vaijayanta; (अस्), m.,
N. of a man.

तिमिर तिमिर, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
तिम्, but rather related to तमस् fr. rt. तम्), dark,
gloomy; (अम्), n. darkness; darkness of the eyes,
blindness; a class of morbid affections of the eyes
seated in the पटल or coats of the eye; gutta
serena, total blindness from affection of the optic
nerve; iron-rust; a sort of aquatic plant [cf. तिमीर
and तिमिष]; (अम्, आ), n. f., N. of two towns.
—तिमिर-नुद्, त्, त्, त्, dispelling darkness; (त्), m.
the sun; the moon.
—तिमिर-प्रतिषेध, अम्, n.,
N. of a chapter of the Uttara-tantra or sixth book
of the Aṣṭāṅga-hṛdaya-saṃhitā by Vāg-bhaṭa,
treating of medicine.
—तिमिर-मय, अस्, ई, अम्,
consisting of darkness; (अस्), m. an epithet of Rāhu
(who creates darkness), or an eclipse in general.
—तिमिर-रिपु, उस्, m. ‘the enemy of darkness,’ the
sun.
—तिमिरारि (˚र-अरि), इस्, m. ‘the enemy of
darkness,’ the sun.
—तिमिरोद्घाट (˚र-उद्˚), N.
of a treatise in verse connected with the Śaiva
dogmas.

तिमीर तिमीर, अस्, m. a kind of tree; [cf.
तिमिर.]

तिमिरय, nom. P. तिमिरयति, -यितुम्, to ob-
scure, darken, eclipse.

तिमिराय, nom. A. तिमिरायते, &c., to appear
dark, to darken.
तिमिरिन्, ई, m. the cochineal insect.

तिमिरि तिमिरि, a kind of fish (not the
तिमि).

तिमिर्घ तिमिर्घ, अस्, m., N. of a man with
the patronymic Daureśruta.

तिमिश तिमिश, probably a wrong reading
for तिनिश.

तिमिष तिमिष, अस्, m. a kind of pumpkin-
gourd, Benincasa Cerifera; a water-melon (ना-
टाम्र).
